items.title: NeSy-RAG: Neuro-Symbolic RAG for Explainable Question Answering
items.title_zh: NeSy-RAG：面向可解释问答的神经符号 RAG
items.summary: NeSy-RAG synthesizes attributable Prolog modules from retrieved text chunks, generating predicates for Boolean claims that may depend on user facts and composing them into queries via joint natural language-code embeddings. A symbolic knowledge-gap detector flags missing user facts whose values affect the query outcome and triggers follow-up interactions; on ShARC the framework reaches 61.1% accuracy versus 42.8% for a same-model RAG baseline without domain-specific training.

items.title: TencentCloud/TencentDB-Agent-Memory
items.title_zh: TencentDB Agent Memory：面向 AI 智能体的团队级记忆中枢
items.summary: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI agents that turns conversations, documents and code into four reusable memory assets - Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki and Code-Graph - that are governed, shared and reused across agents and frameworks. It is written in TypeScript and was trending on GitHub.

items.title: Argus: A General-Purpose Agentic Runtime for Long-Horizon Reasoning
items.title_zh: Argus：面向长程推理的通用智能体运行时
items.summary: Argus is a persistent, self-evolving agentic runtime in which Manager, Planner, Engineer and Reviewer roles execute bounded missions over durable project state. It separates stable user intent from operational objectives and supports memories, skills, procedures and verifiers.

items.title: WebGrader: Training LLMs for Web Development with Self-Evolving Programmatic Grader
items.title_zh: WebGrader：用自演化程序化评分器训练 Web 开发 LLM
items.summary: WebGrader is a self-evolving programmatic grader that derives required interaction flows from each website request, encodes them as executable Flow Contracts and uses their execution outcomes as RL reward, issuing a Pass verdict only after observing the requested transition. On WebGen-Bench it trains an 8B policy to 52.01% functional success, 7.88 points above a matched appearance-plus-script reward and ahead of o4-mini and DeepSeek-v4-flash.

items.title: A Six-Dimensional Taxonomy of Post-Training Adaptation Techniques with Applications in AI Governance
items.title_zh: 后训练适配技术的六维分类体系及其 AI 治理应用
items.summary: This survey organizes post-training adaptation techniques - including retraining, fine-tuning, parameter-efficient adaptation, alignment, retrieval augmentation, model editing, unlearning and calibration - into a six-dimensional taxonomy covering mechanism, goal, data requirement, persistence, structural scope and model type. It distinguishes commonly conflated terms such as fine-tuning, retrieval augmentation and prompting, and maps inheritance, supersession, hybridization and layered deployment relationships.

items.title: Shape Your Feed: An LLM-based Agentic System for Conversational Recommendation
items.title_zh: Shape Your Feed：面向对话式推荐的 LLM 智能体系统
items.summary: Shape Your Feed is an LLM-based agentic recommendation framework with a Perception Flow that captures intent from text, voice and UI interactions, a Serving Flow that reranks candidates against a persistent Semantic Profile, and a Self-Evolution Flow aligned through DPO and an LLM-as-a-Judge ensemble. Its alignment scoring module reaches 98.85% accuracy offline, and large-scale online A/B experiments show improved feed relevance and user sentiment.

items.title: StepJack: Benchmarking Computer-Use Agent Safety Against Multi-Step Indirect Prompt Injection
items.title_zh: StepJack：面向多步间接提示注入的计算机使用智能体安全基准
items.summary: StepJack introduces multi-step indirect prompt injection, an attack class that decomposes an adversarial goal into innocuous-looking sub-steps distributed across a chain of pages along the agent's navigation path, and provides a 480-example benchmark. Across six computer-use agents, multi-step attacks raise attack success rates on three of six at fixed depth, by up to 31.2 points, with GPT-5.4-mini rising from 41.7% at single-step to 72.9% at three-step.

items.title: Towards Reliable Context Compression for Long-Horizon Agents: An Empirical Study of Execution Instability
items.title_zh: 面向长程智能体的可靠上下文压缩：执行不稳定性实证研究
items.summary: This preliminary empirical study shows that recurrent context compression can weaken the influence of recent interactions, increasing blocked actions, repeated exploration and run-to-run instability in long-horizon agents. TRACE addresses this with verifier-guided evaluation of individual compaction events using paired closed-loop continuations from the same environment state, optimizing a natural-language compression prompt with all models frozen; initial AppWorld results improve task performance, multi-run reliability and context-execution efficiency.

items.title: Evaluation Pitfalls and Sparsity Limitations in LLM-based Confidence Estimates for Classification
items.title_zh: LLM 置信度估计的评估陷阱与稀疏性局限
items.summary: The authors show that verbalized LLM confidence estimates are extremely sparse - Qwen3-32B produces only eight unique confidence values on SST-2, with more than half exactly 95% - and that this sparsity biases evaluation metrics such as the area under the accuracy-rejection curve.

items.title: huangruiteng/loopx
items.title_zh: loopx：面向长周期 AI 智能体团队的轻量级循环工程状态内核
items.summary: loopx is a lightweight loop-engineering state kernel for long-running AI agent teams, agent-loop agnostic across Codex, Claude Code and other coding agents, with durable goals, quota-aware auto-wake, executable todos, evidence logs and verifiable handoffs. It is written in Python.

items.title: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5
items.summary: BAAI's bge-small-en-v1.5 sentence-embedding model is trending on HuggingFace with 70.92 million downloads and 525 likes, and is tagged for sentence-transformers.

items.title: Zhang Yiming Says ByteDance's Seed Team Won't Rely on AI Distillation
items.title_zh: 张一鸣称字节跳动 Seed 团队不靠 AI 蒸馏提升模型
items.summary: ByteDance founder Zhang Yiming reportedly told the company's Seed AI research team last month that it would not rely on AI distillation to improve its models, even if doing so meant temporarily falling behind rivals.
